notes.title: The journey continues: Into the Spooky Forest
notes.notes:
[u][b]The story continues![/b][/u]

Now you have to find old Gob and listen to how to get rid of the damn curse. But before he reveals anything there is (as so often) an incident.

Go to the spooky forest and solve the riddle that is hidden behind scary stories.

Overcome traps, darkness, new enemies and a malevolent boss!

By the way, you should stop by Binda in the village, maybe there are a few things to wear?

Update comes 10/15/2022
